model.authorship: Original project geometry authored from the generated concept, using shared original construction helpers. No downloaded models, external textures or fonts.
model.materials: Original authored metre-space ceramic, graphite and directional metal graphs with sparse contact scuffs, 6.5 cm cavity dirt and aft-localized heat tint; Blender-baked color, roughness, tangent normals and cavity occlusion. Main ceramic maps are 2048px, secondary maps 512px. Color is sRGB; data maps are linear. Original baked PNGs and editable source graphs are retained.
model.userDirection: Keep the crescent design, rename Vesper to avoid level-name overlap; reduce toy-like appearance with surface and construction detail.

approval.source: User approval of the completed fleet in the ship expansion chat

artPass.direction: Preserve approved silhouettes, exact hull bounds and propulsion anchors; strengthen formed panel construction, component-specific bevels and canopy seating. Two-layer nozzle cuffs/petals with recessed pressure sleeve, spring keepers and a central emitter carried by three support baffles. Localized straw/blue heat tint, satin service ceramic, saturated painted livery, dielectric canopy, quiet PBR finish and short-range cavity occlusion/roughness. Original authored geometry and procedural textures; no external assets.

finishPass.runtimeTextures: Mipmapped UASTC KTX2 via KHR_texture_basisu; encoder/version/settings and lossless checkpoint are recorded in asset-manifest.json. Original baked PNGs retained.
finishPass.construction: Approved envelope and exhaust anchors retained; formed panel sections, service fasteners, component bevels and recessed intake construction.

cleanPolishPass.direction: Following acceptance of Kestrel's clean-polish pass, the user requested the same finish treatment for the remaining three player ships. Prioritize the complete ship's material response and broad reflections while preserving identity and gameplay integration.
cleanPolishPass.pipeline: assets/ships/clean_finish.py crafted_finish, with shared baking helpers in assets/ships/surface_finish.py and export through assets/ships/build_fleet.py.
cleanPolishPass.finish: Clean coated off-white ceramic, blue-grey service ceramic, dark resin composite, distinct machined alloy and tinted glazing. The current finish removes the earlier abrasion and dirt masks rather than adding new wear.
cleanPolishPass.preserved: Broad crescent wings, compact prow, teal markings, 08, twin engines and named Exhaust_L/Exhaust_R anchors.
cleanPolishPass.textureBudget: Existing 2048px main pearl maps and 512px secondary maps; twenty baked source maps and fifteen packed runtime images. Clearcoat reuses existing normal images. Baked PNGs and editable source graphs remain retained.
cleanPolishPass.presentation: Shared original procedural studio reflection environment, filtered at 256px PMREM resolution, in setup and inspection. Track lighting remains level-owned.
cleanPolishPass.authorship: Original authored Blender geometry and procedural material graphs; no generated texture or external model added. Generated images remain design references only. Visual assessment uses actual Three.js exports.
cleanPolishPass.measurements: Final bounds, triangle/material counts, anchors, encoder settings and runtime hashes are recorded in asset-manifest.json.

finishTarget.role: Selected material/construction target only; not a UV atlas or runtime asset. Silhouette remains the previously approved chassis.
finishTarget.input: Actual Three.js fixed front-three-quarter screenshot of the baseline GLB; saved ship-closeup-v1.png used only for material fidelity.
finishTarget.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. One selected shrike finish target; request 2048x1280 (2K-class). Input 1 is exact edit target, input 2 ONLY surface-fidelity reference. Upgrade this exact ship's surface finish. Preserve silhouette, proportions, canopy, engine count, markings, camera and background. Show formed ceramic panels, graphite structure, machined metal, restrained edge wear, directional fine scratches and dirt in recesses. Preserve clean areas and readable neutral lighting. No new appendages, dramatic relighting, depth-of-field concealment or redesigned ship. Preserve broad crescent wings, teal markings, 08 and twin engines. Finish must convey narrow panel reveals, small formed bevels, flush captive fasteners, clean plate centers, restrained directional machining and localized contact/recess wear. Never copy the reference ship shape.
